_comment: Citation for the Leagues of Votann CURRENT 10e army rule, Prioritised Efficiency, re-introduced as an env-gated simulator combat buff (SWEG_VOTANN_PRIORITISED_EFFICIENCY, default OFF). Before this, the simulator ran Leagues of Votann with NO army-wide combat buff at all: the launch-day Eye of the Ancestors rule was retired and zeroed out (code/units.py RETIRED block, code/simulator.py _maybe_award_judgement_token) after it caused a +16.8 pt Votann over-performance, but the real printed replacement rule was never wired in — leaving Votann factually missing their army rule. This entry covers the +1-to-Hit gate that fixes that gap. The retired-rule marker bookkeeping (judgement_tokens dict, used only as the Ancestral Sentence stratagem eligibility store) keeps its separate citation in data/rule_citations.d/judgement_tokens.json. Rule text is taken verbatim from the BSData v10.6.0 cache (Leagues of Votann.cat.gz, sharedRules rule id 351a-a702-9080-7f08) because wahapedia.ru is unreachable from agent worktrees; the Wahapedia source URL is recorded for human verification per CLAUDE.md rule 6.

simulator.votann_native_reroll_ranged.rule_name: Panspectral Scanning (Hearthkyn Warriors) / Panspectral Scanner (Hekaton Land Fortress) / Decisive Destruction (Einhyr Hearthguard) — per-datasheet native re-roll-a-Hit-roll-of-1 on ranged attacks
simulator.votann_native_reroll_ranged.quoted_text: Panspectral Scanning (Hearthkyn Warriors): 'Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.' Panspectral Scanner (Hekaton Land Fortress, https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/leagues-of-votann/Hekaton-Land-Fortress): 'Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.' Decisive Destruction (Einhyr Hearthguard, https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/leagues-of-votann/Einhyr-Hearthguard): 'Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.'
simulator.votann_native_reroll_ranged.trigger: the env gate SWEG_VOTANN_NATIVE_REROLL is active (ADOPTED default-on, wave 257; SWEG_VOTANN_NATIVE_REROLL=0 is the byte-identical kill-switch); the attacker UnitProfile carries votann_native_reroll_ranged=True (set via overrides.json on leagues_of_votann_hearthkyn_warriors, leagues_of_votann_hekaton_land_fortress, leagues_of_votann_einhyr_hearthguard); and the attack is ranged (Unit.attack mode != 'melee') and not an overwatch attack.
simulator.votann_native_reroll_ranged.effect: Sets att_reroll_hit_ones=True for that ranged attack, i.e. a natural Hit roll of 1 is re-rolled once. Composes by OR with detachment/leader/stratagem re-roll-ones sources (one re-roll per die). APPROXIMATION: Einhyr Hearthguard's 'that targets the closest eligible target' restriction is NOT enforced — Unit.attack has no closest-target signal at the attack call site, so the Einhyr re-roll is applied unconditionally to all of its ranged attacks. This is a deliberate, moderate over-credit following the established Combat Debarkation precedent. Hearthkyn and Hekaton carry no such restriction so their modelling is exact. COMPLEMENTS rank 7: when a Kahl grants the led Hearthkyn [LETHAL HITS], the real rules strip the native re-roll; this unconditional per-unit flag restores it. When SWEG_VOTANN_NATIVE_REROLL=0 (kill-switch) the branch is dead and Votann behaviour is byte-identical to the pre-adoption baseline. ADOPTED wave 257: paired N=80 Votann-scoped, Leagues of Votann +3.77 (44.2 to 47.9, into the noise band of its real 48.0), gated mean absolute error 3.96 to 3.92; the lone decisive Votann lever.

simulator.hekaton_multicog_targeting.quoted_text: Each time this model makes a ranged attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack's Ballistic Skill characteristic; the Hit roll.
simulator.hekaton_multicog_targeting.trigger: the Hekaton Land Fortress makes a ranged attack while at or below damaged_threshold wounds remaining (Damaged bracket), gated SWEG_VOTANN_HEKATON_MULTICOG (ADOPTED default-on, wave 257; =0 kill-switch)
simulator.hekaton_multicog_targeting.effect: ignore any/all modifiers to the attack's Ballistic Skill and Hit roll — in practice the -1 damaged-bracket Hit penalty (hit_mod_delta -= _ghp) is skipped for the Hekaton's ranged attacks; its melee (Armoured wheels) is unaffected. Implemented as a faction+name guard inside the SWEG_DMGBRACKET block in Unit.attack, ranged only. ADOPTED wave 257 as a data-correctness fidelity fix (the simulator was wrongly applying a Hit penalty the rule forbids); metric-inert (paired N=80 Votann-scoped: 2 game flips), adopted for correctness not metric movement. SWEG_VOTANN_HEKATON_MULTICOG=0 is the byte-identical kill-switch.

simulator.prioritised_efficiency.rule_name: Prioritised Efficiency (Leagues of Votann army rule, current 10e codex) — Hostile Acquisition clause
simulator.prioritised_efficiency.quoted_text: If your Army Faction is Leagues of Votann, Leagues of Votann units from your army have one of two abilities: Hostile Acquisition or Fortify Takeover (see below). During the battle, which ability those Leagues of Votann units have will change depending on how many Yield points (YP) you currently have: At the start of the battle, your units have Hostile Acquisition until the start of your next Command phase. At the end of your Command phase, if you have fewer than 7YP, your units have Hostile Acquisition until the start of your next Command phase. At the end of your Command phase, if you have 7YP or more, your units have Fortify Takeover until the start of your next Command phase. Hostile Acquisition: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Hit roll. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit. Fortify Takeover: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, if this unit is within range of one or more objective markers you control, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each time an attack targets this unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than this unit's Toughness characteristic and this unit is not a Vehicle, subtract 1 from the Wound roll. Yield Points: At the end of each player's Command phase, you gain 1YP if you control one or more objective markers within your deployment zone, and, from the second battle round onwards, you gain 1 additional YP for each of the following conditions you satisfy: You control one or more objective markers not within your deployment zone. You control two or more objective markers not within your deployment zone. You control more objective markers than your opponent.
simulator.prioritised_efficiency.trigger: the env gate SWEG_VOTANN_PRIORITISED_EFFICIENCY is active (default OFF); the attacker's army is a Leagues of Votann army (Army.is_votann_army); and the TARGET unit is within range of an objective marker (Unit.attack reads target.on_objective, set per round in Battle._run_round when the unit is within an objective's control radius — exactly the rule's 'within range of one or more objective markers' condition). Applies to both ranged and melee.
simulator.prioritised_efficiency.effect: +1 to the Hit roll for that attack, added to hit_mod_delta in code/units.py Unit.attack and composing with any other +1-to-hit source under the existing 10e +/-1 Hit-modifier cap (hit_mod_clamped) so it never doubles. APPROXIMATION: only the Hostile Acquisition state of Prioritised Efficiency is modelled. (1) The Yield-Point (YP) economy is NOT modelled — there is no YP state machine in the simulator, so the YP>=7 switch to Fortify Takeover never fires; units are treated as permanently in the Hostile Acquisition state, which is the state every Votann army carries at the start of the battle and holds for most of a typical game (reaching 7YP requires several Command phases of winning the objective game). This deliberately errs moderate/under: Fortify Takeover's defensive -1-to-Wound and its attacker-anchored +1-to-Hit (granted only when the Votann player already controls objectives) are NOT modelled. (2) The Hostile Acquisition 'You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit' clause is NOT modelled — the simulator has no per-unit Advance/Charge re-roll plumbing tied to the army rule. Only the load-bearing +1-to-Hit combat clause is implemented. The near-objective CONDITION on the target is implemented precisely (not a blanket army-wide +1), which is what keeps the buff faithful and moderate and avoids repeating the retired Eye of the Ancestors over-buff. When the env gate is OFF the entire branch is dead, leaving the retired-rule-zeroed Votann behaviour byte-identical to the pre-change baseline. Rule text from the BSData v10.6.0 cache (Leagues of Votann.cat.gz, rule id 351a-a702-9080-7f08); Wahapedia URL recorded for human verification per CLAUDE.md rule 6.
